name: lsm-tree
description: Log-Structured Merge-tree (LSM-Tree) storage engine structure featuring MemTable, flushed Sorted String Tables (SSTables), tombstones, and compaction.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to build write-optimized key-value store backends or understand modern database storage compaction internals.

parameters.name: memTableThreshold
parameters.description: Maximum number of keys in the MemTable before flushing to SSTable (default: 3).
